attr.title: Heroes of Loot 2
attr.desc: Switch between heroes to solve dungeon puzzles and fight through monster-filled rooms.
attr.inst: Install HeroesofLoot2.zip, then copy your owned HeroesOfLoot2.jar into the installed heroesofloot2 folder. See heroesofloot2.md for supported files and installation steps. Requires compatible 64-bit ARM firmware and PortMaster Java 17 and Westonpack runtimes.
